title: AI Data Organizer
intro: Design categories, fields and typed tables; review the plan before saving pending material.
goal: How should this material be organized?
sourceHint: Only selected material and pasted text are sent. Character secrets, runtime state and Knowledge are not included by default. Maximum 30,000 source characters.
noPlans: No plans yet. Start with some notes, or design the structure manually.
goalPlaceholder: For example: separate country profiles, population and finance; leave missing values unknown.
dirty: Unsaved edits: save or discard them first.
consent: I approve sending this plan’s selected material to the selected model. Provider charges may apply.
aiHint: AI produces editable proposals only. You can also design manually without an AI connection.
noResult: No structure yet. Add a template or ask AI to design one.
name: Name
inUse: This field is used by records. Resolve those values first.
reuseFixed: Reuses the original template without changing its fields.
noRecords: This plan contains structure only. Save empty tables or add record proposals.
existing: References the original record; no data was copied or overwritten.
quoteBoundary: A matching quote proves its presence, not the correctness of extraction.
confirmHint: Adds categories and pending material, or references original records. Manuscripts, Canon, State and canonical characters are not modified.
confirmCheck: I checked the structure, values, sources and new records.
applied: Saved. Comparison tables read original record fields without storing duplicate values.
emptyTable: No rows yet. Missing values are never filled with zero.
noApplied: Confirm and save the plan to see its actual data tables here.
exportHint: Export is local. Check private material before sharing.
rowsLimit: Up to 200 rows and 16 columns. Changes use the existing save mechanism.
previewStale: The plan changed. Save and preview it again.
rawHint: Data definitions only; code is never executed.
limitHint: Up to 8 templates and 24 records per plan. Organize larger material in batches.
noModels: Design manually, or connect a model in AI interface settings.
running: Task in progress. Closing this page does not replay it.
structOnly: Structure only (no source text or record values)
formatError: Unsupported organization structure or file too large.
snapshotHint: This is the definition snapshot at confirmation. Read current values in Comparison tables or open the original record.
missingRecords: These records were removed; no replacement values were fabricated
appliedBoundary: These records are saved as pending entries. Adopt formal lore separately in the original entry.
noHistoryResults: No matching plans. Clear the search or create a plan.
copyStructure: Reuse structure in a new plan
copyHint: Reuse categories, fields and views only. Choose new sources and a goal. Previous values, sources and AI consent are not copied.
rawPending: JSON changes have not been loaded. Validate and load them, or explicitly discard your edits.
startHint: Describe your goal first. Create a local draft, then edit manually or ask AI to design it.
exampleWorldGoal: Organize world rules, places and factions separately. Preserve sources and leave unknown conditions unknown.
exampleNumbersGoal: Organize resources, stock, production and consumption in tables with units and applicable periods. Do not invent missing values.
examplePlotGoal: Organize plot material by events, participants, prerequisites and planned dates. Distinguish plans from established facts.
pasteHint: Creates a draft only; nothing is automatically sent to AI
noSources: No sources yet. Paste material directly or design an empty structure.
noSourceResults: No matching sources. Try another name.
noReusableTemplates: No existing templates. Create one in the next step.
structureHint: Select a category on the left and edit its fields on the right. Switching keeps your changes.
manualHint: No AI connection required. Add a category or start with an empty numeric table.
nextRecordsHint: Fill in records after defining fields, or confirm an empty template first.
recordsHint: View one record at a time without losing edits. Blank means unknown, not zero.
recordsEmptyHint: New records are pending review, never formal settings by default.
previewNextHint: Save and preview destinations, then explicitly confirm. Nothing is written automatically.
